comparison.objective: Candidate screens finishing media from washers; record trims a card to length on a guillotine cutter.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests bimanual screen manipulation and particle-flow control; record tests card alignment, guarded restraint and blade-handle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% recovery, washer retention and no spill; record requires an 80 mm cut, card alignment, blade-down state and strict hand exclusion from the hazard zone.
comparison.reason: Precision cutting with hazard-zone control tests a different ability from separation through mesh apertures.
